mapper.sql: id, store_code, order_type_config_id, order_cycle_id, truncation_date_time, request_order_no, status_code, total_amount, org_code, biz_org_code, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select:
select oddr.id as requestOrderId,oddr.store_code,oddr.order_type_config_id, odoc.short_order_type,oddr.truncation_date_time,oddr.request_order_no,oddr.status_code, oddr.total_amount,oddr.create_time,oddr.creator, oddr.org_code,oddr.biz_org_code, ootc.order_type_code, ootc.order_type_name FROM
order by oddr.id desc
select group_concat(odo.order_no) from ord_dir_order odo where odo.request_order_id=#{requestOrderId} and odo.biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}

select oddr.id as requestOrderId,oddr.store_code,oddr.order_type_config_id, odoc.short_order_type,oddr.truncation_date_time,oddr.request_order_no,oddr.status_code, oddr.total_amount,oddr.create_time,oddr.creator, oddr.org_code,oddr.biz_org_code, ootc.order_type_code, ootc.order_type_name FROM ord_dir_deliv_request oddr INNER JOIN ord_dir_order_cycle odoc on oddr.order_cycle_id=odoc.id and odoc.store_code=oddr.store_code and odoc.biz_org_code=oddr.biz_org_code and odoc.is_delete=0 inner join opt_dir_order_type_config ootc on odoc.order_type_config_id=ootc.id and odoc.biz_org_code=ootc.biz_org_code and ootc.is_delete=0 where oddr.id=#{requestOrderId} and oddr.is_delete=0

select oddr.id, oddr.store_code, oddr.order_type_config_id, oddr.order_cycle_id, oddr.truncation_date_time, oddr.request_order_no, oddr.status_code, oddr.total_amount, oddr.org_code, oddr.biz_org_code, oddr.creator, oddr.create_time, oddr.updater, oddr.update_time, oddr.is_delete from ord_dir_deliv_request oddr inner join ord_dir_delivery odd on oddr.request_order_no = odd.request_order_no where odd.id =#{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} and odd.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and oddr.is_delete = 0

select odo.id, odo.order_cycle_id, odo.store_code, odo.order_no, odo.order_status_code, odo.order_amount, odo.preferential_amount, odo.source_code, odo.org_code, odo.creator, odo.create_time, odo.updater, odo.update_time, odo.is_delete from ord_dir_order odo where odo.request_order_id=#{requestOrderId} and odo.biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}

select odd.id, odd.delivery_order_no, odd.delivery_status_code, odd.stock_code, odd.distribution_type, odd.sku_count, odd.store_name, odd.store_code, odd.delivery_quantity, odd.delivery_amount, odd.distribution_quantity, odd.distribution_amount, odd.difference_order_no, odd.request_order_no, odd.hd_delivery_no, odd.delivery_time, odd.distribution_time, odd.receive_time, odd.receive_progress, odd.auto_take_delivery_time, odd.take_remark, odd.org_code, odd.biz_org_code, odd.source_no, odd.logistics_no, odd.creator, odd.create_time, odd.updater, odd.update_time, odd.is_delete, odd.remark, odd.is_reversal, odd.is_reversal_order, odd.order_priority, odd.wrh_code from ord_dir_deliv_request_delivery oddrd inner join ord_dir_delivery odd on odd.id = oddrd.delivery_order_id and odd.is_delete=0 and odd.biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode} where oddrd.request_order_id = #{requestOrderId}
